newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Saudi Alujain reviews capital rise, listing.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Alujain reviews capital rise, listing.

text.p: Saudi Arabia's Alujain Corp said on Monday it was studying a plan to increase its paid-in capital to 400 million riyals ($106.7 million) from 173 million riyals and plans to list its shares on the Saudi market.
An official told Reuters the proposal would be submitted to shareholders for ratification early in 1997.

"There is need to increase the capital. The construction of the MTBE plant needs liquidity," he said in reference to plans to start construction in mid-1997 of a 850,000 tonnes a year methyl tertiary-butyl ether plant in Yanbu on the Red Sea.
The official said shares of Alujain would be traded in the Saudi market in the second half of 1997.
